MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 43

3. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 6

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

12. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
